Chatbot Arena Conversations

dataset.chatbot-arena-conversations

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

The complete pinned creatorcard identifies one Chatbot Arena Conversations preference-annotation family:33K paired conversations with explicit human winner votes fromApril–June2023. The primary paper construction/voting, judge-bias/mitigation, separate expert/crowd agreement andappendix consent/release protocols were actually read; available family scope includes rights and limitations. Admit one dataset family conditional on exact existing five subject-bound facts andtheir originalthree-role current-digest proof import. Full_source describes this available primary family documentation scope, not every payload record, later platform release, orreproduced LLMjudge result. The independent1M creatorcard explicitly defines a different single-model conversation corpus collectedApril–August2023, whereas this family has paired conversation_a/b andhumanwinner annotations. Sharedplatform/time/examples may overlap; noexample-disjointness orparent-subset exclusion is inferred. Best-effortPIIremoval/unsafecontent,automatedtags,gatedpayload/modelterms andsplitCCrights remain explicit. MT-bench50experts,paper3KArenaagreement sample and33Kcardrelease are distinct units. Prior stricter nonoverlap-based hold remains historical; criterion is distinct source-backed logical annotation identity withderivation disclosed.
